protocol_name: Serial 1:10 dilution of culture in 0.9% saline
simulated_on: PyLabRobot's STAR model, configured as this instrument

review.protocol: Serial 1:10 dilution of culture in 0.9% saline
assumptions: Scaled the bench 1 mL culture into 10 mL saline to 10 uL culture into 90 uL saline per well (same 1:10 ratio, 1/100 volume).
Number of dilution steps was not stated; chose six (columns 1 to 6, 10^-1 to 10^-6) to span the 10-100 CFU/mL target. Adjust if a different range is expected.
Column 1 holds 10^-1, column k holds 10^-k. Each well is 90 uL saline plus 10 uL of the previous column after mixing (100 uL total).
Each source well is mixed by aspirating and dispensing 50 uL in place before 10 uL is taken for the next column. The last column (6) is mixed at the end.
Culture is in a reservoir so all 8 channels can draw from one source. Each channel takes 10 uL, so 80 uL is needed; 400 uL is loaded for dead volume.
Saline is distributed first using one tip column (90 uL per column, 6 columns, 8 channels = 4320 uL). Loaded 5000 uL.
300 uL filter tips are used because the largest single aspiration is 90 uL; the 50 uL tips are too small.
Each transfer uses a fresh tip column (7 of 12 columns in one rack) so no tip carries liquid between sources.
Off the robot: plating onto agar, colony counting, and incubation. The scientist picks which dilution column(s) to plate to reach 10-100 CFU/mL.
Dilution plate is the deck plate (Cos_96_PCR, 289.7 uL wells); wells start empty and peak at 100 uL, well under capacity.

suggestions.title: 'diluent' starts 4.0 mm deep and ends 0.5 mm deep
suggestions.detail: 5000 uL spreads thin in this container. Below about 2 mm a tip draws air or misses the liquid; the simulator checks volume, not depth. Load more, or use a narrower container (a tube) for a small volume.
suggestions.request: Keep at least 2 mm of liquid in 'diluent' to the end of the run: load more, or move this reagent to a container narrow enough for its volume.

suggestions.title: 6 trips to 'diluent' for 90 uL each, with 360 uL tips
suggestions.detail: One aspirate could feed 4 dispenses, so 2 trip(s) would do instead of 6. Multi-dispensing is less accurate than one aspirate per dispense (the first and last shots differ), so this is a trade of time against precision.
suggestions.request: Fill steps 2-13 by multi-dispensing: aspirate enough for up to 4 dispenses at a time from 'diluent'.
